tools.name: search_eu_textile_regulations
tools.description: Search regulatory evidence in English legal register. Cite original document and unit; verify each claim. Optional scope narrows corpus partitions. No model assesses the answer in this MCP tool; the client must verify each claim against the returned text. Query embeddings use Alibaba; candidate pass

tools.name: search
tools.description: Return cited corpus results by id; use fetch for full source text. The client verifies the evidence. Query embeddings use Alibaba; candidate passages go to Jina for reranking.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch original text by an opaque id from search or document_outline. Pass ids unchanged. Navigation containers have citable=false and child ids, not source evidence. Historical page identifiers return migration guidance.

tools.name: document_outline
tools.description: Return a compact navigation-v1 tree of indexed source text. Source metadata is shared in documents; depth/path encode hierarchy. Pass opaque ids unchanged to fetch. Warnings expose uncertain structure; citable=false marks navigation containers or unverified fragments.

tools.name: find_exact_text
tools.description: Locate a literal string in the current corpus, optionally restricted to a document.

tools.name: list_corpus_documents
tools.description: List indexed document names matching a substring.

tools.name: report_answer_issue
tools.description:
File a report that an answer built from Reecopedia search results was
wrong, misleading or incomplete. The report (the query and the reason,
nothing else — no personal data) enters Reecopedia's human curation queue
and is reviewed weekly to correct the corpus and retrieval quality.

THIS TOOL WRITES

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "report_answer_issue" is 1115 chars, far longer than this server's median (220). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: report_answer_issue · Private data: search_eu_textile_regulations, document_outline, find_exact_text, list_corpus_documents, report_answer_issue · Public sink: report_answer_issue.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: report_answer_issue · Private data: search_eu_textile_regulations, document_outline, find_exact_text, list_corpus_documents, report_answer_issue · Public sink: report_answer_issue

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_eu_textile_regulations" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
